label: noisier_synthetic_v2_readiness
claim_boundary: Readiness scaffold only.  No noisier synthetic v2 data has been generated, no model has been retrained, and no live-agent behaviour has been changed by this artifact.  This is engineering planning infrastructure; it is not clinical validation, real-world readiness, or any kind of model promotion.
why_current_synthetic_data_is_too_clean: Current temporal_ml_rows.csv has deterministic labels, no missingness, no measurement noise, no date jitter, no reporting bias, and a balanced subgroup distribution.  This saturates every metric in the MLE stack (toxicity AUC ~1.0, patient-temporal CV AUC ~0.9996) and prevents the ML and statistical-rigor dimensions of the 10/10-under-constraints roadmap from moving.

planned_noise_types.name: missingness_noise
planned_noise_types.rationale: Real cohorts have missing labs/imaging; current synthetic data has none.
planned_noise_types.planned_distribution: Bernoulli(p=0.1-0.3) per modality per cycle, with patient-block structure.

planned_noise_types.name: label_noise
planned_noise_types.rationale: Real outcome labels disagree across reviewers; current synthetic labels are deterministic.
planned_noise_types.planned_distribution: Symmetric noise rate eta in {0.05, 0.10, 0.15} for binary outcomes.

planned_noise_types.name: measurement_noise
planned_noise_types.rationale: Lab values have analytical variance; current synthetic values are exact.
planned_noise_types.planned_distribution: Multiplicative log-normal noise calibrated to assay CV bands.

planned_noise_types.name: date_jitter
planned_noise_types.rationale: Real records have +/- a few days of date drift around treatment events.
planned_noise_types.planned_distribution: Uniform jitter +/- 3 days per event, preserving ordering.

planned_noise_types.name: symptom_reporting_noise
planned_noise_types.rationale: Patient-reported severity is bursty and inconsistent.
planned_noise_types.planned_distribution: Per-patient over/under-reporting bias drawn once per patient.

planned_noise_types.name: imaging_report_ambiguity
planned_noise_types.rationale: Imaging reports have hedged language; current synthetic reports are crisp.
planned_noise_types.planned_distribution: Hedge-word injection rate in {0.1, 0.2}; impression vs body separation preserved.

planned_noise_types.name: treatment_delay_randomness
planned_noise_types.rationale: Real chemotherapy cycles slip due to non-clinical reasons.
planned_noise_types.planned_distribution: Per-cycle delay ~ Geometric(p) with p tuned to median 0 delay, p95 ~7 days.

planned_noise_types.name: subgroup_distribution_shift
planned_noise_types.rationale: Synthetic cohort is balanced by construction; real subgroups are not.
planned_noise_types.planned_distribution: Reweight subgroup priors per release using documented prior shifts.

blocked_clinical_claims: this synthetic v2 represents real patients
this synthetic v2 establishes clinical performance
this synthetic v2 is FDA / IRB ready
this synthetic v2 is sufficient for deployment
this synthetic v2 replaces real-data validation
expected_evals_before_promotion: leakage audit re-run with patient-level temporal CV under noise
subgroup metrics re-run under each noise type independently
shortcut audit re-run; toxicity AUC must drop below saturation
synthetic data quality proxy with v2-specific disclaimer text
release gate must continue to PASS with v2 artifacts at status: informational
no metric promoted from monitor-only to treatment-influence
why_this_remains_synthetic_only: Noisier synthetic v2 still has no real patient data, no clinician-reviewed labels, and no IRB.  It improves the *measurement surface* by removing saturation; it does NOT close the gap to real data.
